title: The Shell That Wasn't Quite Right

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART III (41-60, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A shell collector finds a nearly perfect pink shell with one tiny chip: keep it anyway, or put it back.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) collects shells, but not just any shells. They have to be pale pink, with exactly one stripe, and no chips anywhere. In all these years (he/she) has found eleven. Today, on the shore, (he/she) finds one that is pale pink, has one stripe, and a chip so tiny you'd need to squint to see it.

choices.label: Put It Back for Someone Else

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) sets it carefully back on the sand. Somewhere on Isola there's someone who collects shells with tiny chips in them. (name1) hopes they find it.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (name1) holds it up to the light for a long time. Then (he/she) puts it in (his/her) pocket. It isn't number twelve. It's eleven-and-a-half. (He/She) finds (he/she) likes it best of all.
